note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 15 November 2026, RealHunt lists 4 homes for sale in the Dominican Republic, each one checked by a person.
In the Dominican Republic, the median asking price of those 4 homes is €223,600 (€2,282 per m², from the 3 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €187,800 and the most expensive €223,600.
Taxes and fees add about 4.25–7% to the price of a home in the Dominican Republic (figures as of 2026).
With 4 homes this is a small sample, so the median for the Dominican Republic is a rough guide.

buying.costs_breakdown: The buyer pays a 3% transfer tax (0% for qualifying first purchases under CONFOTUR tourism incentives), legal fees of about 1-2% and notary fees of about 0.25-1%, plus registration costs, while the seller pays the 2-3% agent fee.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. Foreigners have the same rights as Dominican citizens to buy land and homes, with no restrictions.
buying.annual_property_tax: The yearly IPI tax is 1% of the part of a person's total Dominican property value, as assessed by the tax office DGII, above RD$10,695,494 in 2026, so a single cheap home is often below the threshold.
buying.rental_income_tax: Rent paid abroad to a non-resident is generally subject to 27% withholding.

homes.title: Oceanfront 3-bed flat in Juan Dolio with wide Caribbean views
homes.title_es: Piso de 3 dormitorios frente al mar en Juan Dolio con vistas abiertas al Caribe
homes.place: Juan Dolio, San Pedro de Macorís
homes.summary: A renovated oceanfront apartment in Juan Dolio, on the Caribbean coast east of Santo Domingo, sold ready to live in. 98 m² inside plus terraces (about 200 m² in total), 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and a private parking space. The balcony looks straight over the beach and the sea. About 30 minutes from Las Américas airport and under an hour from Santo Domingo. Asking US$250,000 (about €223,600); the agent's text also quotes US$300,000, so confirm the price.

homes.title: Furnished front-line flat in Juan Dolio with a sea-view balcony
homes.title_es: Piso amueblado en primera línea en Juan Dolio con balcón con vistas al mar
homes.place: Juan Dolio, San Pedro de Macorís
homes.summary: A 2023 apartment on the front line of Juan Dolio beach with direct beach access, sold furnished and ready to move in. 82 m² on the first floor with lift: 2 bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and walk-in closet, living and dining room, kitchen with breakfast bar, laundry area and one parking space. The balcony looks along the whole Juan Dolio coastline. Air conditioning, generator, water tank and 24-hour security. Asking US$210,000 (about €187,800).

homes.title: Front-line beach flat in Juan Dolio with pool and jacuzzi
homes.title_es: Piso en primera línea de playa en Juan Dolio con piscina y jacuzzi
homes.place: Juan Dolio, San Pedro de Macorís
homes.summary: A lived-in, ready apartment on the front line of the beach in Juan Dolio: 105 m², 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, living-dining room, balcony, laundry area and one parking space. The building has a pool and jacuzzi on the sea, covered and open terraces, 24-hour security, a water tank and a generator. About 30 minutes from Las Américas airport. Asking US$250,000 (about €223,600), around US$2,380/m².

homes.title: Furnished beachfront flat on Playa Las Ballenas, Las Terrenas
homes.title_es: Piso amueblado frente al mar en Playa Las Ballenas, Las Terrenas
homes.summary: A 2-bedroom apartment in Bonita Village with direct access to Playa Las Ballenas, one of the best beaches in Las Terrenas, on the Samaná peninsula. Sold fully furnished with an equipped kitchen, ready to live in or rent out straight away. The residence has a large pool in tropical gardens, 24-hour security and power, private parking, laundry and housekeeping, a few minutes from the town centre. About 30 minutes from El Catey airport. Asking US$225,000 (about €201,200), marked as a limited-time offer.
